name: CALCIUM DOBESILATE 250 MG / DIOSMINA 225 MG / HESPERIDIN 25 MG 20 TABLETS
description: The combination of calcium dobesilate 250 mg / diosmin 225 mg / hesperidin 25 mg tablets is a medication that acts as a venotonic and vasculoprotective agent, indicated for treating various conditions related to venous and capillary circulation. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
